title: Teaching contents and formats for prospective ship doctors - survey of experienced ship doctors
summary: In order to further develop the existing training programme for prospective ship's doctors in the German Navy, training participants from the years since 2010 are being asked about their experiences with the training content and their recommendations for future training content and formats. Thus, an initial survey of around 15 training participants will be conducted by means of individual interviews in order to develop questionnaires from the analysed responses, which will then be used to reach and survey as much of the approximately 150 training participants as possible.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Former participants of the naval training ‘Medical Service Introduction to Maritime Medicine’ (of approx. 150 since 2010) with onboard experience in the sense of at least two weeks of independent work as a ship/squadron doctor on a seagoing unit.
Exclusion criteria:
Non-fulfilment of the inclusion criteria and/or refusal to participate
